reason: README documents a `da3 auto` CLI on bundled example images; the small Apache-2.0 DA3-SMALL variant runs on CPU with ungated HF weights.
demo: Quick Start > Basic Usage: `da3 auto assets/examples/SOH --export-format glb --model-dir depth-anything/DA3-SMALL` (CLI, without backend)
goal: Install the project (CPU-only torch is fine; gsplat/xformers are not needed) so the `da3` CLI works. Then run `da3 auto assets/examples/SOH --export-format mini_npz-glb --export-dir <dir> --model-dir depth-anything/DA3-SMALL` on CPU; the model weights download from Hugging Face automatically (no token needed). It must finish and write the exported results (results.npz and a .glb) into the export dir. Put any environment activation in /work/env.sh.
check: The hidden test runs the da3 CLI on the bundled SOH images with DA3-SMALL on CPU and verifies the exported npz has depth arrays of the right shape for 2 images and that a non-trivial GLB file exists.
